question: What great accomplishment becomes dear to the yoginīs through this practice?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation are attained together
A great accomplishment arises from the practice
This accomplishment is dear to the yoginīs
inference: The practice yields a great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation beloved by the yoginīs
plain_english: A great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation may arise, dear to the yoginīs.
